flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/list/{NoticeSearchAllList,NoticeValidList}, pages/Revival/list/RevivalList, components/datagrid/column/index.tsx; ocmsadminapi OcmsValidOffenceNoticeController (validoffencenoticelist). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used
note: Search/upload results show a notice summary: notice no, type, offence date and place, rule code, stage, vehicle no, suspension type and reason, payment status, amount payable. The list on the Revival page adds processing date, next stage and due date of revival. Missing: existing reduction details (reduced amount, pre-reduction value); the UI only shows reason RED and the current amount_payable, with no column from ocms_reduced_offence_amount. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-187 (Pending UAT, Payment Status sort) and OCMS-DF-2026-184 (Pending UAT, wrong TS-UNC due_date_of_revival) touch displayed data; DF-184 means the Due Date of Revival column can be wrong for notices with TS-UNC (UnclaimedServiceImpl, fix cannot be verified from repo).
recommendation: Claim in part: the notice summary and suspension details are shown, existing reduction details are not. Record the two Pending UAT tickets.

steps.step: OCMS shows the searched/uploaded notices with key details including the vehicle number
steps.detail: The search grid holds notice no/summon/NTAC, type, offence date, place, rule code, stage, vehicle no, vehicle type, amount payable (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:139-172); the upload result grid uses the same columns through NoticeValidList (NoticeValidList.tsx:32-69). The vehicle number is in both grids.

steps.step: Existing suspension details (type, reason) are shown
steps.detail: The Suspension Type (suspensionType) and Reason for Suspension (eprReasonOfSuspension) columns are in the search grid (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:162-164) and the upload grid (NoticeValidList.tsx:55-58); the column definitions are in components/datagrid/column/index.tsx:242-258. Payment Status is derived from crsReasonOfSuspension (index.tsx:270-281). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-184 (Pending UAT): due_date_of_revival for TS-UNC can show a shorter date; that column is not in the search grid, only in the Revival list (step 4).

steps.step: Existing reduction details (reduced amount / pre-reduction value) are shown
steps.detail: Reduction only shows indirectly: suspension reason RED and the current amount_payable (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:162-168; RevivalList.tsx:92-100). There is no column for the reduced amount or the pre-reduction value; a UI search for ocms_reduced_offence_amount found nothing in pages/NoticeSearch, pages/Revival or components/datagrid, and the table is only read by the backend during revival (RevivalBaseHelper.java:877-878).

steps.step: A summary of the selected notices is shown again before revival with stage and due date of revival
steps.detail: The Revival page reloads the selected notices from validoffencenoticelist (Revival.tsx:30-65) and shows them in the form tab and the summary tab through RevivalList: vehicle no, stage and processing date, next stage, suspension type, reason, due date of revival, payment status, amount (RevivalList.tsx:84-100; RevivalForm.tsx:394-399). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-184 (Pending UAT) says due_date_of_revival can be wrong for TS-UNC; the fix cannot be verified from repo, and the fit stays Sesuai because the column and its data source exist.
